scientific_limitations: The exact finite-parameter Littlestone dimension is not determined in general.
The online asymptotic is for each fixed positive defect r, not uniformly growing r.
The elementary class count and the cyclic-window special case r=1 are not presented as independent discoveries.
Historical priority is unresolved under alternative cyclic-string and combinatorial-learning terminology.
title: Fixed-weight cyclic independent sets: a one-logarithm online boundary effect
